task.description: Design and implement test coverage for ADP-01. Produce/update test spec and concrete tests that validate tenant_id additive behavior in event store, tenant-scoped ordered and global reads, and default-tenant backward compatibility for legacy flows. Ensure tests explicitly cover migration-side expectations and deterministic behavior for missing tenant context as specified in design. Add or update tests in appropriate backend test locations and include traceability to ADP-01 and impacted ES requirements. Keep test scope focused on ADP-01 acceptance and non-regression.
acceptance_criteria: ADP-01 test spec exists with traceability to acceptance criteria
Automated tests cover tenant-scoped and default-tenant compatibility behavior
Tests are executable by TEST-RUNNER without manual preconditions beyond documented env
Edge cases for missing tenant context are asserted deterministically

result.summary: Test specs and integration test coverage for ADP-01 were implemented, covering default-tenant compatibility, tenant isolation, migration/index expectations, and deterministic missing-tenant context handling.
